scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @orion/contracts build && pnpm --filter @orion/orchestration build && pnpm --filter @orion/agent-catalog build && pnpm --filter @orion/test-fixtures build && pnpm --filter @orion/server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.smoke:workspace-import: pnpm --filter @orion/orchestration exec node --input-type=module --eval "await import('./dist/index.js')" && pnpm --filter @orion/agent-catalog exec node --input-type=module --eval "await import('./dist/index.js')" && pnpm --filter @orion/test-fixtures exec node --input-type=module --eval "await import('./dist/index.js')"
